svg.aria-label: Nine trials of grid search and nine of random search on a toy problem where only the horizontal hyperparameter matters. The grid tries only three distinct values of it and misses the minimum; random search tries nine different values and lands close to it
svg.title: Nine trials of grid search and nine of random search on a toy problem where only the horizontal hyperparameter matters. The grid tries only three distinct values of it and misses the minimum; random search tries nine different values and lands close to it
svg.text: Nine trials: a grid tries 3 values of what matters, random search 9
toy loss; only the horizontal hyperparameter matters (above each panel: its effect)
the dashed line marks the true minimum, loss -0.356
